name: league-registration
description: Renders ```league-registration code blocks as a player registration form on league pages, and ```league-creation blocks as a form for creating a league.

quartz.name: league-registration
quartz.description: Player registration and league creation forms

endpoint.description: URL the form POSTs registrations to (the Cloudflare Worker). Leave empty until it exists.

createEndpoint.description: URL the league creation form POSTs to (the Cloudflare Worker). Leave empty until it exists.

turnstileSiteKey.description: Cloudflare Turnstile site key (public). When set, the form shows the Turnstile check.
